Slop Sheets · Beta

Spreadsheet viewer

Open and browse spreadsheets on this device. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Sheets has these main features: Opens XLSX, CSV and TSV, several files as tabs; Sort and filter any column, then export what you see. It opens Excel (.xlsx), Excel (.xls), CSV, TSV.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Sheets

  • Open an XLSX file without Excel
  • Open a CSV file as a table
  • Convert XLSX to CSV
